citations.quote: Irene serves as the Deputy Director & Chief Strategy Officer for Workforce Connections, Southern Nevada’s Local Workforce Development Board.
she’s currently the deputy director and chief strategy officer at the Workforce Connections development board
Bustamante Adams, a Democrat, served four terms in the Nevada State Assembly before she was elected to represent District F on the Clark County School Board in 2022.
The District F race features incumbent Irene Bustamante Adams, a former Democratic state lawmaker who currently works in workforce development.
